channel.title: Muhammad Alif Blog
channel.description: Open Source Developer building meaningful and purposeful software that solves real problems beyond technical complexity.

item.title: Hermes Agent Changed How I Turn Ideas Into Reality
item.description: An always-on personal agent changed where my work begins, reducing the distance between an idea and real execution across tools, environments, and interfaces.

item.title: AI Is Changing Almost Everything
item.description: In less than four years, AI moved from conversational answers to persistent agents that can reason, use tools, operate environments, and act on human intent.

item.title: Context Engineering Is Replacing Prompt Engineering
item.description: The hardest part of building reliable AI systems is increasingly not what you ask the model, but what the model is allowed to know when it decides what to do next.

item.title: The Agent Harness Is Becoming the New Application Layer
item.description: A powerful model is no longer enough to define a powerful AI product. The runtime around it decides what the model can see, what it can do, and how its work survives failure.

item.title: Evals Are Becoming the CI/CD Layer for AI Agents
item.description: An agent works perfectly during development, then production tells a different story. Evals are becoming the layer that measures whether agent behavior is still correct after every change.
